cq-ticket.label: Quiz builder ticket frame (full composition)
cq-ticket.notes: Reference composition; Turing slots real rows. Notches at y=96 and perforation at bottom separate the sticky Start bar.

cq-tickbox.label: Lesson tick box (box in currentColor, red tick in .cq-tick)
cq-tickbox.notes: Hide .cq-tick for unchecked. Pair with a 6px module-accent bar (CSS var --cq-accent). Themeable via currentColor; dark is null, set color: var(--cq-ink).

cq-slider.label: Slider rail, ochre fill and pencil knob
cq-slider.notes: Knob group .cq-knob: translate X along rail (14..306). Pencil tip marks the value.

cq-toggle-useall.label: "Use all" pencil switch (on | off)
cq-toggle-useall.notes: Two states side by side; crop with viewBox 0 0 64 36 (on) or 70 0 64 36 (off), or rebuild in CSS with vars.

cq-marked-paper.label: Graded "teacher's marked paper" results sheet
cq-marked-paper.notes: Background; dashed boxes are question slots (x100,w440). Red margin line at x=80, marks sit in the margin.

cq-heat-notebook.label: Heat-tinted notebook page with legend
cq-heat-notebook.notes: Heat = red hatch density levels 0-4 (patterns #h1..#h4 + theme). Rebuild rows from data; ids are suffixed light/dark to avoid clashes when both inline.

cq-teacher-page.label: Teacher student-file notebook page
cq-teacher-page.notes: Header in Gochi Hand reads "Mr. Dimitry's notes". Modules chips use module accent at 33% alpha.
